title: Workable jobs input
description: Read one or more public Workable boards and get every open posting.

boards.title: Boards
boards.description: Workable board identifiers (the part before workable.com), or full board URLs. Example: celsius, prx, https://apply.workable.com/fuku/. Duplicates are read once.

includeDetails.title: Include descriptions
includeDetails.description: Put the posting description into each row. The board call already carries it, so this only decides whether it lands in your dataset (rows get large).

descriptionFormat.title: Description format
descriptionFormat.description: html keeps the employer markup as it is; text strips tags, decodes entities and collapses whitespace. Ignored when includeDetails is off.

maxJobsPerBoard.title: Max postings per board
maxJobsPerBoard.description: How many matching postings to process per board. 0 means no limit. Postings past the limit are counted, never charged.

sortBy.title: Sort postings by
sortBy.description: Which date decides the order before maxJobsPerBoard is applied.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma separated phrases; a posting matches when any phrase occurs in its title, department or function. Example: engineer, data scientist. Empty means no keyword filter.

department.title: Department contains
department.description: Case insensitive substring of the department.

function.title: Function contains
function.description: Case insensitive substring of the function.

industry.title: Industry contains
industry.description: Case insensitive substring of the industry.

employmentType.title: Employment type contains
employmentType.description: Case insensitive substring, for example Full-time or Contract.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country name or ISO code; a posting matches when any of its locations is in that country. Example: DE or Germany.

remoteOnly.title: Remote only
remoteOnly.description: Keep postings the board itself flags as remote.

publishedAfter.title: Published after
publishedAfter.description: YYYY-MM-DD; keeps postings published on or after that day.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Timeout for one board call. A very large board can take a while.
